test_auth_public_datasets: test public dataset access with token, cookie, and no authentication methods

test_auth_private_datasets: test private dataset access returning unauthenticated or not supported errors based on auth type

test_enterprise_private_datasets: test enterprise user and org private dataset access with expected error codes
